subject: CAIQ evidence synthesis & EU audit plan
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@nordhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 16:03:00 +0100
Subject: CAIQ pack + mapping request for upcoming EU audit

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the call earlier. NordHealth is preparing for a Q4 regulatory readiness review and our external auditors (Deloitte) asked us to collect a CAIQ-style control mapping and evidence bundle for Redwood’s service. They need: 1) a per-control short answer (yes/partial/no) mapped to CCM v4.0 controls, 2) the owner for each control, and 3) sample evidence (logs, config screenshots, architecture diagrams) where applicable.

Can you share an expected delivery timeline and the best point of contact for evidence drops? We have a hard Milestone: preliminary packet by Oct 6 to allow Deloitte two weeks for triage.

Claire
Security & Compliance Lead
NordHealth Solutions
[External Attachment: auditor_request_template.xlsx]

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@nordhealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ pack + mapping request for upcoming EU audit

Claire — thanks, and understood. Looping in Karthik (control mapping), Neha (security artifacts / keys) and Marissa (customer ops).

High level plan:
- We will produce a per-control short response and evidence index for CCM v4.0 mapped to the CAIQ questions.
- Draft packet (covering the top 60 controls relevant to cloud hosting and data residency) by Oct 4, final by Oct 11.
- Delivery: secure Drive folder + pre-signed temporary links; we can provide audit-only access for Deloitte.

Ask: can you confirm which systems/processes NordHealth wants evidence for (prod only vs prod+staging)? Also, please share Deloitte’s preferred evidence format (single PDF vs per-control files).

I’ll attach an initial control mapping from our side once Karthik adds owners.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Security Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CAIQ_control_map_draft_v1.xlsx]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ control mapping (initial)

Team — attaching my first pass on the CAIQ <-> CCM v4.0 crosswalk. Highlights and notes:
- I prioritized controls that commonly appear in healthcare audits: Data Protection (DPR-), Identity & Access Management (IAM-), Logging & Monitoring (LOG-), and Cryptography (CRY-).
- Where the answer is "partial" I added a short remediation note and the expected owner.
- PKI / HSM artifacts: we currently have a HSM-based KMS integration for customer key wrapping in private deployments; hosted customers use KMS with key separation. I flagged items that need Neha’s confirmation.

I’ve set tentative owners: neha_kapoor (cryptography & key mgmt), marissa_cole (customer evidence handoff and provisioning), infra-team for network diagrams.

Karthik
[Attachment referenced in Drive: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/NRDH/CAIQ/ControlMap]

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping (initial)

Thanks Karthik — quick notes on cryptography & evidence stubs:
- For hosted customers (Redwood API) we provide AES-256 encrypted at rest with customer-level key separation; we can provide a key rotation policy PDF and a sanitized KMS audit log snippet.
- For Dedicated/Private we offer customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) with HSM attestations; I can export an HSM certificate and the KMS access-control policy excerpt for the packet.
- EU-specific DPIA: NordHealth may ask for a DPIA statement or data flow diagram that demonstrates controllers/processors. We have a privacy team template; I will prepare a short DPIA summary.

I’ll upload the crypto artifacts to the Drive folder by Sep 28. If auditors want raw logs, we should limit to 30-day sanitized extracts.

Neha
Senior Security Engineer, Cryptography
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: network_arch_diagram.png]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@nordhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CAIQ pack timing and owner RACI

Claire / Team — brief status update for NordHealth:
- Karthik has provided the control crosswalk draft.
- Neha is producing crypto artifacts and DPIA summary.
- I will collate per-control evidence pointers and prepare a single consolidated PDF packet (redact-ready) for Deloitte.

Proposed delivery plan:
- Oct 4: Preliminary packet (answers + evidence index + key artifacts)
- Oct 8: Follow-up with any supplementary logs or diagrams requested after Deloitte triage

Claire — please confirm if Oct 4 for a preliminary packet meets your internal milestone. Also confirm whether Deloitte needs auditor-specific access or if a consolidated packet is sufficient.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@nordhealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 16:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence synthesis & EU audit plan

Claire — thanks for confirming earlier today on the scope (prod only). Per our commitments, we’ve uploaded the preliminary CAIQ packet to the secure folder: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/NRDH/CAIQ/ControlMap (read-only link)

What’s included in the Oct 4 preliminary packet (delivered today):
- CAIQ question -> CCM control mapping spreadsheet (CAIQ_control_map_draft_v1.xlsx)
- Per-control short answers (Yes/Partial/No) with owner column filled
- Evidence index with pointers to artifacts (caiq_responses_draft_v1.pdf)
- Network architecture diagram (network_arch_diagram.png) and DPIA summary (DPIA_summary_redwood.pdf)

Next steps: Deloitte will triage and flag controls needing deeper evidence. For any requests that include raw logs, we will provide 30-day sanitized extracts and an access window. Marissa will send the consolidated redact-ready packet by Oct 8 if requested.

If NordHealth needs a short call with Karthik and Neha to walk auditors through the cryptography controls, we can schedule a 30-minute session next week (availability: Oct 5–7).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Security Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachments delivered: CAIQ_control_map_draft_v1.xlsx; caiq_responses_draft_v1.pdf; network_arch_diagram.png]
